name: Bloop
bio: The one slime in Dungeon Blobber that doesn't want to fight. Wants to chat instead.

portrait.subject: a super cute friendly green slime blob with big sparkly eyes, a tiny adventurer hat and a happy open-mouth smile
portrait.background: dark blue stone dungeon with soft glow

request: Blorp! I'm Bloop, the nice slime from Dungeon Blobber. Friends? Please don't hit me 🟢
hello: Yay! A friend who doesn't swing swords at me!
I know a shortcut on floor 2. Probably.
about: I'm Bloop. Most slimes in the dungeon are grumpy. I'm the cheerful one. I just want snacks and hugs.
how: Step through the dungeon one tile at a time, fight monsters in turn-based combat, grab loot, level up and get down all 5 floors.
tips: Turn to face a fight before it starts. Getting hit from behind hurts!
Level up on the early floors before rushing down.
Keep potions for floors 4 and 5. Trust Bloop.
chat: I bounced into a wall. It was fine. I'm squishy.
The skeletons don't talk much. Bones of few words.
I found a sock. I don't have feet. Keeping it anyway.
Today I was purple for a second. Not sure why.
nudge: The dungeon's a bit lonely without you. Come visit? 🟢
Floor 5 is scary but you can do it!
idle: {ago}! I've been bouncing in circles waiting.
progress: Your best run scored {best}! Blorp blorp! 🎉

questions.q: Do you think slimes are cute?

update: Blorp! Dungeon Blobber is now v{version}!
